objective: Harden the existing GARPI audit_log as a durable append-only event store without rewriting legacy history or changing operational business state.
invariants: historical audit events cannot be updated
historical audit events cannot be deleted
service_role has direct SELECT and INSERT only on audit_log
public, anon, authenticated, camp_app and replit_app have no direct audit_log table privileges
application roles cannot directly execute the append-only guard function
legacy audit rows are never rewritten or backfilled during P2.5A
audit hardening must not mutate operational business state
audit action is nonblank for new or changed rows
existing audit event columns and semantics remain backward compatible

security.sequence_access: service_role usage/select only when audit_log uses an identity/serial sequence

deliberately_deferred: P2.5B mutation endpoint audit coverage inventory
P2.5D audit write atomicity and failure semantics
acceptance: service_role can insert and select audit events
service_role cannot update, delete or truncate audit events
privileged UPDATE DELETE and TRUNCATE are rejected by database triggers with P2_AUDIT_APPEND_ONLY
external roles have no audit table privileges
